mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are tracking clear skies and eighty-eight degrees near Verona Area High School. Tonight will be a great night for stargazing under a waxing crescent moon, with a visible pass of the International Space Station starting at ten nineteen PM.

The City of Verona is promoting sustainability initiatives, including apartment composting drop-offs at Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop, solar energy purchasing programs, and rebates for residents who install rain barrels or buy energy-efficient toilets.

We have plenty of local activities on the horizon, starting with live music and the Mount Horeb Art Fair on July eighteenth, followed by the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park on Wednesday, July twenty-second.

In the weekly police recap, officers responded to a vehicle versus bicycle crash last Friday morning, July tenth, at Old PB and Whalen Road, resulting in minor injuries to the cyclist and a citation for the driver.

You can wrap up your day with a sweet treat at Culver's, where today's Flavor of the Day is Chocolate Caramel Twist. They are open until eleven PM tonight, and if you miss out, tomorrow's flavor is Really Reese's.
